language.name: English
start.welcome:
Hi {name}! Welcome to Bazarche.
Use the menu below to browse products, check your cart or track your orders.
catalog.empty_category: This category has no products right now.
catalog.not_found: This product is no longer available.
admin.panel:
🛠 Admin panel
What would you like to do?
admin.no_categories: There are no categories yet. Add a category first.
admin.no_products: This category has no products yet.
admin.ask_category_name: Send the name of the new category (or /cancel):
admin.category_exists: A category with this name already exists. Send another name:
admin.ask_price: Send the price in toman (numbers only):
admin.ask_stock: How many are in stock? (numbers only)
admin.invalid_number: Please send a valid whole number, for example 120000.
admin.too_long: That is too long. Please send at most {limit} characters.
admin.ask_new_description: Send the new description, or /skip to remove it:
cart.added: ✅ Added to your cart (now {quantity} in cart).
cart.title: 🛒 Your cart:
cart.unavailable: This product is no longer available.
common.too_long: That is too long. Please send at most {limit} characters.
checkout.ask_name: Let's place your order. Please send your full name:
checkout.ask_phone: Please send your phone number, or tap the button below:
checkout.invalid_phone: That doesn't look like a phone number. Please send it again, for example 09121234567.
checkout.ask_address: Please send your full delivery address:
checkout.cancelled: Checkout cancelled. Your cart is still saved.
checkout.placed:
✅ Your order #{order_id} has been placed.
We will message you whenever its status changes.
orders.title: 📦 Your orders (newest first):
orders.cannot_cancel: This order can no longer be cancelled.
orders.status_changed: 📦 Your order #{order_id} has a new status: {status}
admin.invalid_transition: This change is not allowed for the order's current status.
admin.ask_new_photo: Send the new photo, or /skip to remove the photo:
admin.need_photo: Please send a photo (not a file or text), or /skip.
